findings.title: Access checks repeated across three flows
findings.rationale: load_account, assert_permission and record_access run in sequence in user_login, password_reset and account_close.
findings.suggestion: Extract the three-call sequence into one authorize helper.

findings.title: retry_webhook is not reached by any mapped flow
findings.rationale: Not reached by any of the 9 mapped flows — confirm before deleting. Tracing cannot see reflection, dependency injection or configuration-declared entry points.
findings.suggestion: Check for dynamic callers and configuration references, then decide.

findings.title: dispatch_event has a fan-out of 6
findings.rationale: dispatch_event calls 6 functions directly, below the fan-out threshold of 8.
findings.suggestion: Group the routing and logging calls into two helpers.

findings.title: build_fixture_payload is kept alive only by its own tests
findings.rationale: Kept alive only by its own tests: not reached by any of the 9 mapped flows, only from test files — confirm before deleting. Tracing cannot see reflection, dependency injection or configuration-declared entry points.
findings.suggestion: Confirm whether production still needs it, or keep it as test-only support.
